description: This file defines the ActivationTaskScheduler class, a specialized task scheduler for managing in-order, single-concurrency task execution per activation within Orleans runtime. It provides methods for queueing, executing, and inline execution checks of tasks, along with logging and optional statistics collection.

classes.name: ActivationTaskScheduler
classes.description: A task scheduler ensuring in-order, single-threaded execution for activation work, with logging and optional statistics.

methods.name: GetScheduledTasks
methods.description: Returns the current queued tasks within the worker group.

methods.name: RunTaskFromWorkItemGroup
methods.description: Executes a task received from the work item group, with inline execution.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task for execution by the scheduler.

methods.name: TryExecuteTaskInline
methods.description: Attempts to execute a task inline if conditions are met, verifying context and task state.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including scheduler ID and work queue count.
